name: OCaml
typeSystem: Static, strong, inferred (Hindley-Milner-based), algebraic data types
runtime: Compiled to native (ocamlopt) or bytecode (ocamlc), with GC

runtimes.name: Native (ocamlopt)
runtimes.role: Optimising native-code compiler for production builds.

runtimes.name: Bytecode (ocamlrun)
runtimes.role: Portable bytecode run by the ocamlrun virtual machine.

runtimes.name: js_of_ocaml
runtimes.role: Compiles OCaml bytecode to JavaScript for the web.

concurrencyModel: OCaml 5: parallelism via domains; effect handlers support user-level schedulers; Lwt/Async provide cooperative concurrency

codeExample.source:
let rec fib = function
  | 0 -> 0
  | 1 -> 1
  | n -> fib (n - 1) + fib (n - 2)

let () =
  List.init 10 Fun.id
  |> List.map fib
  |> List.iter (Printf.printf "%d ")
  |> print_newline
